tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_spirit_breaker_char:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.
Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.
Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
No other units will be hit by Greater Bash if it's not drafted as well. Target of Charge of Darkness will be stunned on impact even without Greater Bash.
Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker_bio: Barathrum the Spirit Breaker is a lordly and powerful being, a fierce and elemental intelligence which chose to plane-shift into the world of matter to take part in events with repercussions in the elemental realm that is his home. To that end, he assembled a form that would serve him well, both in our world and out of it. His physical form borrows from the strengths of this world, blending features both bovine and simian--horns, hooves and hands--as outward emblems of his inner qualities of strength, speed and cunning. He wears a ring in his nose, as a reminder that he serves a hidden master, and that this world in which he works is but a shadow of the real one.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker_hype: Highly mobile and always aggressive, Spirit Breaker charges across the map to bring the fight to his enemies. With each bash of his heavy lantern, he knocks his foes senseless. His enemies may run, but with the help of a few wards, they cannot hide.

fields.value: Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.

Fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects.

Barathrum starts charging at a lower charge speed, and gradually winds-up to the max charge speed.

buff2text
fields.value: Charge of Darkness Target: Charging this hero!

fields.name: buff4text
fields.value: Bull Rush: Movement speed from Charge of Darkness lingers on Spirit Breaker.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
<!--[[File:Dota2 Spirit Breaker Charge of Darkness Indicator.png|thumb|150px|Visual indicator above the charged target.]]-->

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness_vision}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
** {{M|Exposes}} the unit-targeted enemy upon cast.
** Does not grant the unit-targeted enemy the 1800-radius {{M|shared vision|text=caster vision}} on Barathrum.
** All vision components applied by the ability cast does not affect {{M|neutral creeps}}.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} While charging:
** Grants Barathrum flat {{M|movement speed}} bonus and removes the [[movement speed cap]].
** Applies {{M|forced movement}} on Barathum, utilizing his current movement speed as the travel speed.
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|ForcedMovement {{=}} Current[[Movement Speed|MS]]}}
** Non-targeted ability casts do not interrupt Charge of Darkness.
** {{Symbol|Greater Bash}}
*** Applies Greater Bash of its corresponding level on enemy units within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Charge of Darkness type1 value1}} radius while charging.
**** Can only affect the same enemy units once per cast.
**** The bash radius has a {{#var:Charge of Darkness type1 value2}}-distance offset.
**** Hence, it can affect enemy units {{#expr:{{#var:Charge of Darkness type1 value1}}-{{#var:Charge of Darkness type1 value2}}}}-distance and {{#expr:{{#var:Charge of Darkness type1 value1}}+{{#var:Charge of Darkness type1 value2}}}}-distance of Barathrum's back and front respectively.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Couriers}}
**** The unit-targeted enemy.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Can auto-attack enemy units within {{M|attack range}} with {{Key press|autoattack/always}} enabled.
*** Both the charge indicator and the target {{M|buff}} are visible ally-only.
**** Pinging the {{M|buff|x}} prints a message indicating the charged enemy unit.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Arrival}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Applies the following ability effects on the unit-targeted enemy upon arrival:
*** A {{M|stun}} instance that utilizes the {{Code|modifier_stunned}} {{M|debuff}}.
*** Applies a 0.1-second {{Code|special_attack}} hidden {{M|buff}} that procs an ensured {{A|Spirit Breaker|Greater Bash}}.
*** Issues an attack order to Barathrum.
*** {{M|Trees}} within 150-radius centered around Barathrum are destroyed.

* For situations when two opposing units casts Charge of Darkness and are charging toward each other, the latter Charge of Darkness instance applies all ability effects.

* The ability has the following properties:
** The {{M|cooldown}} starts once the charge ends, or when being interrupted, not upon cast.
** May manually end the charge with the following commands:
*** {{cf|Hotkey|S}} Stop order.
*** {{cf|Hotkey|H}} Hold position order.
*** Any targeted order.
*** {{M|Shift-queue}} orders, except {{cf|Hotkey|P}} patrol commands.
** The following sources interrupts Charge of Darkness:
*** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
*** {{M|Fear}} sources.
*** {{M|Forced movement}} sources.
*** {{M|Hex}} sources.
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
*** {{M|Root}} sources.
*** {{M|Sleep}} sources.
*** {{M|Stun}} sources.
*** {{M|Taunt}} sources.
** {{M|Silence}} sources do not interrupt Charge of Darkness.

* The following units are considered valid for the charge target transfer:
** {{M|Untargetable}} units.

* The following units are not valid for the charge target transfer:
** {{M|Invisible}} units.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: The signature strike of Barathrum's ghostly ball and chain.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Has a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack that deals a portion of Barathrum's current movement speed as damage.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value:
[[Roshan]] is innately immune to all forced movement sources.

However, the damage component still applies.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value:
Whenever a Greater Bash-affected unit cascades with another enemy unit, the secondary enemy units are also damaged, stunned, and knocked back.

Enemy units killed this way will keep cascading back and knock other enemy units.

Increases knockback distance and height.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value: The cascading effect is less effective on enemy creeps.

fields.name: dt desc0
fields.value: The ability upgrade has a fixed downtime upon proc. Cannot be reset with cooldown reset sources.

fields.name: interacts
buff2text
fields.value: Bull's Hit: Greater Bash chance at x%.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The proc chance is determined during the Barathrum's {{M|attack point}}, and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Greater Bash value1}}}}.
** Cannot proc on the following units:
*** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
*** {{M|Buildings}}.
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* Does not stack with other {{M|bash}} sources.

* The {{Code|knockback}} {{M|debuff}} applies both the {{M|knockback}} and {{M|stun}} duration.
** {{M|Trees}} within 100-radius coming in contact with, centered around the affected enemy unit are destroyed.

* Does not goes into {{M|cooldown}} upon the following source procs:
** {{A|Spirit Breaker|Charge of Darkness}}
** {{A|Spirit Breaker|Nether Strike}}

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Both the {{M|knockback}} and the {{M|stun}} {{M|debuff|x}}.
*# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# The proc source's ability effect sequence or Barathrum's attack instance.

* Has a {{#var:Greater Bash basic1}} ({{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Greater Bash basic1}}*1.3}}|agh}})-height with {{calc|v1/{{#var:Greater Bash value4}}|v1={{#var:Greater Bash value3}}}}-{{M|knockback}} speed upon proc.
** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** The {{M|upward movement}} results in a small arc for visual purposes.

* {{cf|aghnotes}}
** Grants 175 flying vision around the affected enemy units.
** Nether Strike also has a 0.6 internal cooldown for this ability effect.

* math

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Grants self magic resistance bonus for the entire spell redirection duration.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Does not interrupt an ongoing Charge of Darkness upon cast.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Acquiring {{M|Aghanim's Shard}} unlocks this ability in the {{Spellslot|4|5}}. * Has the following properties while active: ** The unit-targeted ability is {{M|Spell Block|text=blocked}}, then redirected utilizing {{M|Spell Redirection}} to Barathrum. ** Abilities redirected can still be affected by other Spell Reflection sources (e.g. {{A|Lotus Orb|Echo Shell}}). * Grants the following bonuses while active: ** Has a {{M|magic resistance|x}} of {{calc|1-(1-{{G|magic resistance}})*(1-v1)|v1={{#var:Planar Pocket type1 value1}}|%}}. ** Planar Pocket increases the total {{M|magic resistance|x}} by {{calc|(1-v1)*{{G|bonus magic resistance}}*10|v1={{#var:Planar Pocket type1 value1}}|%}} per 10 {{M|intelligence}} points.

* Only redirects abilities cast by heroes. ** Treat ability casts from {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps. * The following mechanics uniquely apply to Planar Pocket: * {{Symbol|Planar Pocket}} {{M|Spell Block}} has the following priorities: *# {{A|Anti-Mage|Counterspell}} *# Planar Pocket, {{A|Linken's Sphere|Transfer Spellblock}} and {{A|Linken's Sphere|Spellblock}}. * Has the same proc precedence as {{I|Linken's Sphere}}-based {{M|Spell Block|x}} sources, if the unit-targeted ability redirects to Spirit Breaker, all sources proc at the same time. * {{Symbol|Planar Pocket}} {{M|Spell Redirection}} has the following priorities: *# {{A|Anti-Mage|Counterspell}} *# {{A|Lotus Orb|Echo Shell}} *# Planar Pocket

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Barathrum temporarily returns to the realm from where he came, bringing with him the retribution of both worlds.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim and striking it.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of its corresponding level occurs, while knocking back his victim for double the normal distance.

This ability component levels up with {{A|Spirit Breaker|Greater Bash}}.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|nether_strike_vision}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
* Applies a  debuff on the affected enemy upon the {{M|cast point}}, and has the following properties:
** The debuff is removed once the ability cast is either executed or canceled.
** {{M|Exposes}} and does not grants {{M|True Sight}} over the affected unit.

* The ability has the following properties:
** Has a {{#var:Nether Strike value1}}-[[cast range buffer]].
*** The unit-targeted enemy has to move to {{Code|> {{#expr:{{#var:Nether Strike value1}}+{{#var:Nether Strike cast range}}}}-distance}} from Barathrum during the ability's cast point to be considered out of range.
** After the {{M|cast point}}, Nether Strike {{M|teleports}} Barathrum to the opposite side of the target, {{#var:Nether Strike basic2}} range away from it.
*** Neither {{M|disjoint}} projectiles upon cast and upon {{M|teleport|x}}.
** {{Symbol|Greater Bash}}
*** Applies a 0.1-second {{Code|special_attack}} hidden {{M|buff}} that procs an ensured {{A|Spirit Breaker|Greater Bash}} of its corresponding level.
*** Has a {{Code|{{#var:Nether Strike basic1}}}} Greater Bash {{M|knockback}} distance factor.
*** When an enemy unit is perfectly aligned with Barathrum and the unit-targeted enemy, it is not knocked aside.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# The {{A|Spirit Breaker|Greater Bash}} instance.
*# Nether Strike's {{M|magical|x}} {{M|spell damage|x}}.
*# Barathrum passively issues an attack order on the affected target, regardless of the auto-attack settings.

* Affects the following units:
** {{M|Couriers}}
